blockers.title: Applicant age is below the minimum requirement
blockers.user_message: You must be at least 16 for the Student visa. Under-16s need the Child Student visa.
blockers.recommended_next_step: If you are under 16, review the Child Student visa route. The Student visa requires applicants to be at least 16.

blockers.title: Valid passport not confirmed
blockers.user_message: A valid passport is required. Renew before applying if needed.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Obtain or renew your passport before continuing. A valid passport is required to apply.

blockers.title: Passport may expire before the end of your planned course
blockers.user_message: A passport expiring during your stay should be renewed first to avoid complications.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Renew your passport before applying so it remains valid for the full duration of your planned stay.

blockers.title: Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) not yet received
blockers.user_message: The CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is mandatory. No application can proceed without it. An offer letter is NOT a CAS.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Contact your institution to request your CAS. No UK Student visa application can be submitted without one.

blockers.title: Institution may not hold a valid UKVI student sponsor licence
blockers.user_message: Only licensed sponsors can issue a valid CAS. Verify your institution yourself on the public Register of Licensed Student Sponsors — agents sometimes push unlicensed 'colleges'.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Verify your institution on the Register of Licensed Student Sponsors at GOV.UK before applying or paying fees.

blockers.title: CAS has already been used in a previous application
blockers.user_message: A CAS can only be used once. If it was used in a prior (e.g. refused) application, request a fresh CAS from your sponsor.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Request a new, unused CAS from your institution before reapplying.
blockers.rule_source_name: CAS Must Be Unspent and Match Personal Details Exactly

blockers.title: CAS details do not match passport or application documents
blockers.user_message: Any mismatch between CAS and passport/documents (a common Pakistani refusal cause — name spelling, DOB, fee figure) can cause refusal. Check every field and ask the sponsor to correct errors BEFORE applying.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Ask your institution to correct the CAS. Check name spelling, date of birth, passport number, course title, fees, and dates against your passport.
blockers.rule_source_name: CAS Must Be Unspent and Match Personal Details Exactly

blockers.title: CAS is older than 6 months (for outside-UK applicants)
blockers.user_message: A CAS older than 6 months is invalid for outside-UK applications. Request a fresh CAS if needed.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Request a fresh CAS from your institution. Outside-UK applications require a CAS issued within the last 6 months.
blockers.rule_source_name: CAS Must Not Be Older Than 6 Months (Outside UK Applicants)

blockers.title: Course qualification level is below RQF Level 3
blockers.user_message: The Student visa requires a course at RQF Level 3 or above (most degrees are Level 6+). Below that is not eligible.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Confirm your course level with your institution. The UK Student visa requires a course at RQF Level 3 or above.
blockers.rule_source_name: Course Must Be at RQF Level 3 or Above

blockers.title: Available funds fall below the required maintenance threshold
blockers.user_message: Required = (first-year tuition minus deposit paid) + living costs (£13,761 London / £10,539 outside). Funds must be genuine and held correctly for 28 days.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Calculate your required funds (unpaid first-year tuition plus living costs) and ensure your balance meets that figure before applying.

blockers.title: Funds have not been held continuously for the required 28-day period
blockers.user_message: The 28-day rule is strict: the balance must NEVER dip below the required total at any point in a 28-consecutive-day window. A single large deposit just before applying fails this. (Unlike Australia, the UK enforces a hard 28-day period.)
blockers.recommended_next_step: Maintain your required balance without any dip below the threshold for a full 28 consecutive days, ending close to your application date.

blockers.title: Bank statement closing date is more than 31 days before application
blockers.user_message: The statement closing date must be no more than 31 days before you apply, or the evidence is rejected.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Obtain a bank statement whose closing date is within 31 days of your planned submission date.

blockers.title: Parental relationship proof or consent letter not confirmed
blockers.user_message: Parent/guardian funds require BOTH a relationship document (Family Registration Certificate or birth certificate) AND a signed consent letter allowing you to use the funds. Missing either = refusal.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Obtain both a relationship document (Family Registration Certificate or birth certificate) and a signed written consent letter from the parent or guardian providing the funds.
blockers.rule_source_name: Financial Evidence Must Be Genuine, Sourced and Correctly Held

blockers.title: Valid English language evidence not confirmed
blockers.user_message: Below-degree courses need a SELT from a UKVI-approved provider; general IELTS is NOT accepted — it must be IELTS for UKVI / PTE Academic UKVI / LanguageCert SELT etc. Degree-level courses may use a university assessment recorded on the CAS.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Obtain a valid SELT from a UKVI-approved provider, or confirm with your institution that its English assessment is correctly recorded on your CAS.

blockers.title: English test provider is not UKVI-approved
blockers.user_message: Only UKVI-approved SELTs count (IELTS for UKVI, PTE Academic UKVI, LanguageCert, etc.). A normal academic IELTS taken at a non-SELT centre is invalid for below-degree courses.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Retake the English test at a UKVI-approved SELT centre (e.g. IELTS for UKVI, PTE Academic UKVI, LanguageCert SELT). A standard academic IELTS is not valid for below-degree courses.

blockers.title: English test result does not meet the required CEFR level for this course
blockers.user_message: Below-degree: B1 (~IELTS 4.0). Degree level: B2 (~IELTS 5.5) in all four skills. A score below your course level fails.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Retake the SELT and achieve at least B1 for RQF Level 3–5 courses or B2 for degree-level courses (RQF Level 6 and above).
blockers.rule_source_name: Minimum CEFR Level by Course Level

blockers.title: SELT result is older than the 2-year validity period
blockers.user_message: A SELT older than 2 years is invalid; you must retake it.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Retake the SELT to obtain a current result. Results must be no more than 2 years old at the time of application.
blockers.rule_source_name: SELT Result Must Not Be More Than 2 Years Old

blockers.title: TB certificate from a UKVI-approved clinic not confirmed
blockers.user_message: For Pakistani applicants staying 6+ months, a TB test from a UKVI-APPROVED clinic (e.g. IOM Islamabad/Karachi/Lahore) is mandatory. A normal hospital chest X-ray does NOT count. Missing it = automatic refusal.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Book and complete a TB test at a UKVI-approved clinic (such as IOM in Islamabad, Karachi, or Lahore) and obtain the certificate before applying.
blockers.rule_source_name: TB Test Mandatory for Pakistani Applicants (6+ Month Stay)

blockers.title: ATAS clearance not confirmed for a course that requires it
blockers.user_message: Where required, ATAS must be obtained BEFORE submitting the visa application. Applying without it = refusal.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Apply for ATAS clearance through the GOV.UK ATAS portal before submitting your visa application.
blockers.rule_source_name: ATAS Certificate Required for Sensitive STEM Postgraduate Subjects

blockers.title: Unable to pay the Immigration Health Surcharge in full upfront
blockers.user_message: IHS (~£776 per year of stay) must be paid in full during the application — no instalments. It's separate from the ~£524 visa fee.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Ensure you have the funds to pay the IHS in full at the time of application. No instalment option is available. Verify the current IHS rate on GOV.UK before applying.
blockers.rule_source_name: Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) Must Be Paid Upfront

blockers.title: Prior immigration history may not be fully disclosed
blockers.user_message: Concealing immigration history is treated as deception — a 10-year ban from the UK. Disclose everything, even old or minor matters.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Disclose all prior refusals, overstays, and removals accurately and completely in your application.
blockers.rule_source_name: Full Immigration History Must Be Accurately Disclosed

blockers.title: Document authenticity cannot be fully confirmed
blockers.user_message: A single fabricated document (bank balance, experience letter, transcript) triggers refusal under deception rules and a 10-year ban — even if an agent did it. Verify authenticity of everything.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Personally verify every document and form answer in your application. Replace or remove any document that may have been altered or exaggerated.

blockers.title: CAS does not correctly record the university English assessment
blockers.user_message: If your university assessed your English (degree-level courses), the CAS must record it. A blank/incorrect CAS English field can force you to take a SELT.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Ask your institution to update your CAS to correctly record its English assessment. An incorrect or blank English field may require you to obtain a separate SELT.

blockers.title: Tuition fees already paid are not recorded on the CAS
blockers.user_message: Fees shown as paid on the CAS reduce the tuition amount you must evidence. If your deposit isn't recorded, ask the sponsor to fix the CAS — it directly changes your required funds.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Ask your institution to update the CAS to reflect the deposit or fees you have paid. An incorrect fee figure directly affects how much you must evidence.

blockers.title: Funds are not held in an accepted account type
blockers.user_message: Funds must be in your own name or a parent's/legal guardian's. Funds in a brother's, uncle's, or family-friend's account are NOT accepted for maintenance (different from the US/Canada sponsor model).
blockers.recommended_next_step: Ensure maintenance funds are in your own account or a parent's or legal guardian's account. Third-party accounts are not accepted as evidence under UK Student visa rules.
blockers.rule_source_name: Financial Evidence Must Be Genuine, Sourced and Correctly Held

blockers.title: Source of funds cannot be fully documented
blockers.user_message: Caseworkers query unexplained money. Each significant amount needs proof: registered sale deed, FBR-declared salary, sanctioned loan letter, or a notarised gift affidavit from a traceable giver.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Gather documentary evidence for every significant deposit — registered sale deeds, FBR-declared salary slips, formal bank loan sanction letters, or notarised gift affidavits from traceable sources.
blockers.rule_source_name: Financial Evidence Must Be Genuine, Sourced and Correctly Held

blockers.title: Sponsor does not appear to have FBR filing history consistent with declared funds
blockers.user_message: Large funds with no FBR/filer history imply undeclared income and weaken credibility if source is questioned. Declared income should plausibly support the amount.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Confirm whether the fund sponsor has a consistent FBR filing history. Large funds without declared income history weaken the credibility of the financial evidence.
blockers.rule_source_name: Financial Evidence Must Be Genuine, Sourced and Correctly Held

blockers.title: Unable to specifically explain the choice of UK and this institution
blockers.user_message: If a credibility interview happens, generic answers hurt. Name the course content, ranking, or specialization and tie it to your background and a Pakistan-based career. Random/agent-picked universities are a red flag.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Prepare a specific, personal explanation for why the UK and this particular university were chosen, connecting the course to your academic background and career plans in Pakistan.

blockers.title: No clear link between the course and a realistic career in Pakistan
blockers.user_message: Show the path: your background -> this UK course -> a named role/sector in Pakistan. No logical payoff at home weakens credibility.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Prepare a clear explanation of how this UK course connects to a specific role, sector, or employer in Pakistan.

blockers.title: Applicant may not be able to discuss their own course details
blockers.user_message: Credibility interviews probe whether you actually understand what you signed up for. Not knowing your own modules/fees/duration signals an agent-driven, non-genuine application.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Ensure you know your course modules, tuition fees, location, and duration well enough to discuss them confidently without relying on notes.

blockers.title: Ties to Pakistan may not be clearly demonstrable
blockers.user_message: While the UK route allows some switching later, credibility still weighs intent. Be ready to describe concrete ties and a return/career plan.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Identify and document concrete ties to Pakistan — property ownership, family business involvement, a written career plan, or family responsibilities.

blockers.title: Education or employment gap of over 12 months is not evidenced
blockers.user_message: Provide employment letters, salary slips, freelance proof, or transcripts covering the gap. Unevidenced 'I was at home/preparing' is weak.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Gather documentary evidence covering the gap period — employment letters, salary slips, freelance contracts, or academic transcripts.

blockers.title: Academic progression may not meet UKVI expectations
blockers.user_message: UKVI scrutinises 'academic progression'. Going from a Masters back down to a lower diploma, or a drastic field switch, looks non-genuine and must be justified.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Ensure the UK course represents clear academic progression from your previous qualification. If a downgrade or switch is involved, prepare a credible explanation.

blockers.title: Significant change of academic field identified
blockers.user_message: A big, unexplained field switch is a credibility trigger. If yes, be ready to explain the logic clearly.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Prepare a clear, credible explanation for the field switch, connecting your previous qualification and this UK course to a coherent career narrative.

blockers.title: Academic records may not be complete, consistent, or verifiable
blockers.user_message: Inconsistent/unverifiable academics (mismatched names/dates, missing transcripts) raise fraud concerns. Have complete, attested records ready.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Ensure all academic transcripts and degrees are complete, consistently named, and attested where required (HEC for degrees, IBCC for Matric/FSc).

blockers.title: Name or date of birth inconsistency across documents
blockers.user_message: Name/DOB mismatches (e.g. 'Muhammad' vs 'Mohammad', differing spellings on degree vs passport) are a very common Pakistani refusal cause. Reconcile every document to the passport spelling before applying.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Reconcile your name spelling and date of birth across all documents — passport, CAS, academic certificates, and financial papers — before applying.

blockers.title: Visa application may not fully match CAS details
blockers.user_message: The application form, CAS, and bank evidence must tell one consistent story. Contradictions read as deception.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Cross-check your visa application form against your CAS for course title, fees, dates, and personal details before submitting.

blockers.title: Prior visa refusal identified
blockers.user_message: Prior refusals are visible and probed. A refusal is survivable IF disclosed and explained — concealment is treated as deception with a 10-year UK ban risk.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Ensure the prior refusal is accurately disclosed in your application. Prepare a clear explanation of what has changed since the previous application.
blockers.rule_source_name: Full Immigration History Must Be Accurately Disclosed

blockers.title: Prior immigration breach (overstay or removal) identified
blockers.user_message: Overstays/removals must be disclosed and explained; concealment risks a ban.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Disclose this history fully and honestly. A prior overstay or removal is a significant concern that must be addressed candidly in the application.
blockers.rule_source_name: Full Immigration History Must Be Accurately Disclosed

blockers.title: Prior asylum claim identified
blockers.user_message: An asylum history conflicts with a temporary-study application and must be addressed candidly, ideally with legal advice.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Disclose your asylum history fully. Consider seeking qualified legal advice before applying given the potential impact on demonstrating temporary-student intent.
blockers.rule_source_name: Full Immigration History Must Be Accurately Disclosed

blockers.title: Dependant eligibility may not be met under current rules
blockers.user_message: From 1 Jan 2024, only full-time PhD/research-degree students (or government-sponsored students) may bring dependants. Taught Masters/undergraduate/sub-degree students CANNOT. Applying with ineligible dependants causes problems.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Confirm your eligibility to bring dependants. Since January 2024, only PhD or research-degree students and government-sponsored students may bring dependants.
blockers.rule_source_name: Dependants Restricted to PhD/Research Students (From 1 Jan 2024)

blockers.title: Application may not have been personally reviewed by the applicant
blockers.user_message: Some agents inflate balances, fake experience/bank letters, or alter transcripts. If an agent fabricated anything, YOU face refusal and a deception finding (10-year ban). Verify every line yourself.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Review every document and form answer submitted in your name. You are legally responsible for all submitted content regardless of who prepared it.

blockers.title: Agent has reportedly advised concealing information
blockers.user_message: If an agent told you to conceal something, that's a path to a deception finding and a 10-year ban. Disclose truthfully; ignore that advice.
blockers.recommended_next_step: Discard that advice. Disclose all relevant information accurately. Acting on advice to conceal information does not provide legal protection and creates a serious risk.
